basics.name: Alice
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer
basics.summary: Backend engineer with eight years building payments and route optimization systems. Happiest when keeping the ledger correct and keeping the pager boring turn out to be the same project.

work.name: Acme Inc.
work.description: Payments infrastructure for Acme's retail storefronts
work.summary: Own the settlement ledger and the payout pipeline that moves money to about 900 storefronts every night.
highlights: Cut settlement mismatches 83% by making every payout write idempotent
Led the migration of nightly settlement batches to an event-sourced design
Reduced p99 payout confirmation from 40s to 6s by taming retry storms

work.name: Acme Inc.
work.description: Route optimization for Acme's regional delivery fleet
work.summary: Built the dispatch services that plan routes for 3,000+ drivers across the Pacific Northwest.
highlights: Rebuilt the dispatch planner, cutting route computation from 35 minutes to under 4
Shipped the driver status API used at the door to confirm every delivery

projects.name: volley
projects.description: Open-source Go library for retry-safe HTTP clients
highlights: 1.4k GitHub stars, with production use in public SDKs at three companies

volunteer.summary: Mentored career-switchers building their first backend projects at a free weekly workshop.

awards.title: Employee Innovation Award
awards.summary: For the barcode tooling that now ships in every warehouse the company serves.

publications.name: Why Your Idempotency Keys Keep Going Stale
publications.summary: A walkthrough of expiry strategies for safe write retries against non-deterministic payment backends.

references.name: Bob, Engineering Director, Acme Inc.
references.reference: Alice is the engineer you hand your scariest migration to and then breathe normally again. The dispatch planner rebuild never cost us a single angry driver call.
